frame_files: frames/<anim>/NN.png (RGBA 384x576, transparent; the water is drawn into every frame)

water_surface.fixed: same y in EVERY frame of the set (swim, turn, leap); only the small ripples move
water_surface.ripple_formula: y = surface + A1 sin(2pi x/L1 - 2pi t/18) + A2 sin(2pi x/L2 + 4pi t/18) (x, y in px of the frame; t = frame phase)

phase.swim: t = frame index 0..17 (same for both facings)
phase.leap: t = 18 j / 19 for leap frame j (0 .. 19): frame 0 = phase 0, frame 19 = phase 18 = 0

drawing.line: blue line + light highlight above it
drawing.band: light blue, alpha 0.3 at the surface -> 0 over 73 px
drawing.tint: submerged character pixels tinted toward [120.0, 185.0, 240.0] by 0.24..0.4 (deeper = more)
drawing.foam: where the body crosses the surface
drawing.shimmer: light dashes under the line, drift one spacing per cycle

swimmer.below: hair ends, body, legs, big tail (tinted)

tail_splash.fx: small crown at the crossing + droplets when it breaks out; small re-entry splash + ring when it goes back in

water_surface.leap: starts from and falls back into the same surface line; parts under the surface tinted, the burst / re-entry drawings fade out under the water

ds_swim_full_turn_to_right.note: squash pop sx 0.80 (old facing, phase 0) -> 0.88 (new facing, phase 1) -> 1.0; continue from frame 2 so tail stroke and ripples continue without a jump

ds_swim_full_leap.play_after: ds_swim_full frame 17 (seamless; from any other frame the ripples jump once)

gifs.back_and_forth: previews/ds_swim_full_back_and_forth.gif (72 frames: left 2-17, 0-17 -> turn -> right 2-17, 0-17 -> turn -> loops)
